text: Erzincan tulum is ripened in a goatskin by the milk's own lactic bacteria. A trial that added a yoghurt-type starter to pasteurised ewe's milk shortened the making from 10-12 days to about 2.

steps.note: The cheese is left to rest overnight.
No culture is added in the traditional method; the raw milk's own bacteria ferment it.

processing.text: Ripened in a goatskin at altitude. A quick method adds 0.5 % starter (Streptococcus salivarius subsp. thermophilus and Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus 1:1) to pasteurised ewe's milk and cuts making from 10-12 days to about 2.
